'''RZ7-6113-23''' was a rocky, [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[class-6 planetoid]] that was devoid of life. It was located in the [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Located in a remote sector of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], RZ7-6113-23 was a small [[class-6 planetoid]]. A largely barren and volcanic planetoid that was devoid of life,<ref name="CE3.1" /> RZ7-6113-23 was nevertheless the site for a large [[RZ7-6113-23 base|military storehouse]].<ref name="CE3.3" />

==History==
{{Quote|We are in an outpost built secretly during the early days of Palpatine's rule. Numerous weapons and ships scheduled for decommission of destruction were rerouted here over the years, repaired and maintained.|Ennix Devian|<ref name="CE3.3" />}}
During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a storehouse was secretly built on the planetoid. Various outdated hardware officially known to be retired from the Imperial army, such as the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] and the [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]], were rerouted from impoundment to the storehouse.<ref name="CE3.3" /> By [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the warlord [[Ennix Devian]] had established his headquarters in the storehouse, leading a splinter faction of the Galactic Empire known as the "[[Restored Empire]]," otherwise known as the hard-liners. Having lost faith in the direction of the Imperial Remnant under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], Devian planned to use the storehouse's supplies to assemble an army large enough to launch an attack on the Imperial capital [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], establishing a new order worthy of the late [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] vision.<ref name="CE3.3" /> At one point, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] was [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|destroyed]] by an Imperial hard-liner projectile cannon fired from the surface of the planet.<ref name="CE3.1" />

As part of his plot, Devian had the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]] member [[Kir Kanos]] abducted and taken to RZ7-6118-23 in an attempt to recruit him. However, Kanos's conflicting code of honor led him to reject the offer, and escaped the planetoid in a stolen [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] after a massive firefight in the Imperial storehouse; however, this was part of Devian's plan.<ref name="CE3.3" /> Soon after Kanos left, a New Republic warship arrived in the system, investigating the disappearance of the ''Endor''. Devian was forced to abandon his base, commanding a diversionary [[Battle of RZ7-6113-23|attack]] on the ship while the rest of his forces retreated.<ref name="CE3.4">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 4]]</ref> The storehouse was rigged to self destruct, and once a Republic ground force infiltrated it, the entire complex exploded.<ref name="CE3.5">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 5|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planetoid RZ7-6113-23 made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|first issue]] of [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost'']], the third installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]'' trilogy. [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era ship designs on RZ7-6113-23 mark the debut of [[prequel trilogy]] starship designs in the ''Crimson Empire'' series, as the previous installment, [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'']], released in [[1998]], a year before the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
